description: Evidence from the window leading up to a failure, plus a baseline comparison: the incident window measured against the equal window before it, per dimension (exceptions, network volume/failures/latency p50/p95, jank ratio, log errors, memory) with directions new/spiked/increased/decreased and citable evidence. Anchors on the given eventId, or the most recent exception, or the current time. Network uses interval matching, so a request that started before the window but failed inside it still counts. When the baseline predates observation, directions are unknown rather than fabricated.

eventId.description: Anchor on this event (e.g. 'exc_00142'). Defaults to the most recent exception.

windowMs.description: How far back to look, in milliseconds.

name: what_changed
title: What changed before an incident
